snippet.title: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine - Trailer
snippet.description:
Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine - Trailer

Help Flibbius solve the mystery of the crashed flying machine and take to the skies in our upcoming puzzle, adventure, cozy game.

Flibbius releases on the 28th April 2025. Join us for an adventure of a lifetime (well, Flibbius' lifetime at least)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296920/Flibbius_McDoogle_and_the_Mysterious_Flying_Machine/?beta=1

Special thanks to Lung Animation studio for making this incredible cinematic.

Credits:
Lung Animation Studio
Jamie Treselyan - Actor & Narrator
Matinino - Music
Blended Audio Studios - FX
- Pieter Matthyser & Massimo Meneghetti
